title: Alleged silent credit wraparound
report_body: Solidity 0.8.20. Complete relevant code: mapping(address=>uint8) credit; function add(uint8 amount) external {credit[msg.sender]+=amount;} There is no unchecked block or assembly. Account credit is 250. add(10) reverts with arithmetic panic and storage remains 250. Report specifically claims a successful silent wrap to 4. No denial of service or other finding is alleged.
